verdict: Yes, as a kiosk or café. The Croffle Guys from Mumbai pitched desserts and waffles on Shark Tank India Season 5 and got a deal. Trendy desserts like croffles attract young crowds, but trends fade, so keep costs low.
angle: Waffles, croffles and dessert cafés are popular near colleges and malls. A small menu keeps costs low. Social media drives discovery.
